description: Get the pulse of one rikma as numbers: members, open missions, missions in progress, open resources, open decisions (votes), active timers, missions finished and hours logged in the last N days, and when anything last happened. Use it to judge whether a rikma is active before planning. Members only; no per-member financial data. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#getProjectStatsTool
name: getProjectStatsTool
